abstract: OBJECTIVE: Patients with nonseminomatous germ cell cancer of the testis with no evidence of metastatic disease after orchiectomy may be managed with either retroperitoneal lymph node dissection or surveillance. The present retrospective study was undertaken to determine the accuracy of CT for revealing retroperitoneal lymph node metastases in patients with newly diagnosed clinical stage 1 testicular nonseminomatous germ cell cancer of the testis when smaller size criteria (smaller than 10 mm) are applied and to test the hypothesis that CT-revealed anterior retroperitoneal lymph nodes are more likely to correlate with metastases than are posterior lymph nodes. MATERIALS AND METHODS: Abdominal CT scans obtained before surgery in 70 patients were reviewed by three observers who were unaware of the results of retroperitoneal lymphadenectomy. The sizes and sites of all lymph nodes measuring larger than or equal to 4 mm were recorded. Each CT scan was judged as positive or negative for retroperitoneal metastasis on the basis of the size of the largest measured lymph node at the expected metastatic site. Diameters of 4, 6, 8, and 10 mm were successively applied to each case as the criteria for a positive scan. RESULTS: Using a criterion of 10 mm or larger for metastases, we calculated a sensitivity of 37% and a specificity of 100%; with a 4-mm criterion, the sensitivity was 93% and the specificity was 58%. Receiver operating characteristic curves comparing the accuracy of CT for revealing similar-sized lymph nodes located anterior or posterior to a line bisecting the aorta differed significantly (p = .04) when the same criteria were applied to lymph nodes in both regions. CONCLUSION: False-negative rates were decreased from 63% using a size criterion of 10 mm to as low as 7% using a size criterion of 4 mm, with a corresponding decrease in specificity. Lymph nodes measuring larger than or equal to 4 mm, especially those located anterior to the mid portion of the aorta, should raise a suspicion of metastases.

目的：臨床病期Iの精巣非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の新規診断例において、より小さなサイズ基準(10mm未満)を適用した場合のCTによる後腹膜リンパ節転移検出の精度を求めること。また、大動脈中央部の前後の正中線を境に、前方に位置するCT所見のリンパ節が後方のリンパ節よりも転移と相関しやすいという仮説を検証すること。
材料と方法：術前の腹部CT画像70例を、後腹膜リンパ節郭清の結果を知らない3名の観察者が読影した。4mm以上のすべてのリンパ節のサイズと部位を記録した。各CTは、予想される転移部位の最大リンパ節のサイズに基づき、後腹膜転移の陽性か陰性かを判定した。4、6、8、10mmの直径を、各症例の陽性判定基準として順次適用した。
結果：転移の基準を10mm以上とした場合、感度37%、特異度100%であった。4mmを基準とした場合、感度は93%、特異度は58%であった。大動脈の正中線の前方と後方に位置する同サイズのリンパ節について、CTによる検出精度を比較したROC曲線は、同一の基準を両領域に適用した場合に有意差があった(p=.04)。
結論：偽陰性率は、10mmの基準では63%だったが、4mmの基準では7%まで低下した。その分特異度は低下した。4mm以上のリンパ節、特に大動脈中央部の前方に位置するものは、転移を疑うべきである。
